description: This file defines the 'StockStatus' model class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing stock status records in the database, including CRUD operations, caching, and related data handling.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Model class for handling stock status data, including addition, editing, deletion, retrieval, and descriptions management in the database.

methods.name: addStockStatus
methods.description: Creates a new stock status record in the database based on provided data across multiple languages.

methods.name: editStockStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing stock status record, replacing its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteStockStatus
methods.description: Deletes a stock status record from the database.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all stock status records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stock status record by its ID.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of stock status records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStockStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of stock status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds or updates a description for a stock status in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a given language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stock status description by stock status and language IDs.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific stock status.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all stock status descriptions for a specific language.
